<!--
Measured, not read: the space between a table's rules and the text beside
them, the same in the .pdf and typst, measured in the ink of both. The .pdf
sets it with booktabs; typst with the padding and rules formattypst.lua
gives each table (apatablecells in the template). A table without a head
has a rule over it and under it only.

Every word measured here has no descender, so that the foot of its ink is
its baseline.
-->
